name: io.github.tonyyang0504/emag-mcp
description: eMAG Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EMAG_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username of the API user created in your eMAG Marketplace seller account (the user must be granted API rights, and eMAG only accepts calls from the IPs you whitelisted with them); sent as HTTP Basic.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EMAG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that API user; sent as HTTP Basic.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EMAG_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: API host of your platform: marketplace-api.emag.ro (eMAG RO), marketplace-api.emag.bg (BG), marketplace-api.emag.hu (HU), marketplace-ro-api.fashiondays.com or marketplace-bg-api.fashiondays.com (Fashion Days); calls go to https://<api_host>/api-3/...
